decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans SR/AJD/01 submied 17 November 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding approved plans SR/AJD/01, the rear dormer should be built with a pitched roof, in accordance with the plans of the rear elevations on plans SR/AJD/01.
description: Extension of timeframes of planning permission 00442/89/P8 dated 16/12/2008 for a proposed pitched roof and rear roof extension over first floor extension
